product_family: Website behavior analytics platform with session replay, heatmaps, surveys, form analytics, and AI-powered insights. Includes Sense AI for automated analysis.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Contentsquare is... holds a SOC 2 Type II report.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Hotjar is ISO 27001, 27701, 27017 & 27018 certified, these internationally recognized standards confirm their commitment to information security, privacy, and compliance.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Hotjar is PCI DSS compliant which means that our security policies, and procedures meet the requisite standard. Additionally, Hotjar holds a Certificate of PCI-DSS Merchant Compliance. Hotjar performs an annual PCI DSS assessment.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Hotjar has undertaken the required business and technological steps to operate in a manner compliant with GDPR. Additionally, Hotjar has appointed a Data Protection Officer (DPO) to ensure that Hotjar processes all personal data it collects in compliance with the GDPR.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Hotjar will not sign a business associate agreement, and therefore is not HIPAA compliant. Hotjar lists compliance with GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, PCI-DSS, and SOC 2 Type II, but HIPAA is not included in its compliance commitments.

certifications.name: NIST
certifications.proof_quote: Hotjar's trust center at trust.contentsquare.com includes security policies, compliance certifications (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, NIST), and other documentation.

privacy.ai_training_note: Contentsquare AI models are trained on aggregated, anonymized behavioral data only. Customer data is never shared with third parties or used to train external AI models. All AI features comply with enterprise-grade security and privacy standards.
privacy.data_region: Ireland (AWS eu-west-1 region, with redundancy across 3 availability zones)

security.name: Network Access Control
security.value: All traffic blocked by default, only required ports opened. Elevated access requires VPN with 2-factor authentication.

security.name: Database Backups
security.value: Full daily backups stored on AWS S3, retained for 3 days

security.name: Infrastructure Redundancy
security.value: Production infrastructure deployed across 3 availability zones in eu-west-1 AWS region in highly-available configurations

security.name: Data Isolation
security.value: Application and database servers run inside Amazon VPC with limited access on need-to-know basis

security.name: Sensitive Data Protection
security.value: Credit card and sensitive payment data explicitly not stored by Hotjar. Payment processing delegated to Braintree (Level 1 PCI DSS compliant provider).

security.name: Default Privacy Mode
security.value: User keystrokes automatically suppressed by default. No recording of credit card details, phone numbers, or sensitive form data.

products.name: Hotjar (Free/Growth Plans)
products.data_scope: Behavioral interaction data (clicks, scrolling, mouse movement, session replays, surveys). No credit card data. Aggregated/anonymized for AI training only.
products.notes: Now integrated into Contentsquare unified platform. Free plan includes heatmaps, session replay, surveys, error monitoring, funnels, 10+ integrations. Growth plan adds advanced features.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (free plan with 200k sessions/month) + paid growth/scale tiers
compare.data_residency: Ireland only (AWS eu-west-1). No option for other regions.
